summary: Keep inherited fixture tools when temporary ancestor names contain incidental st2 substrings

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: CI fixture PATH isolation and launch checks recognize case-insensitive, delimiter-separated st2 path components instead of arbitrary substrings. Actual st2 executables and legacy installation directories remain excluded; generated-output and stored-record checks are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Only CI boundary helpers and their regression tests change.

recovery.detail: No persistent state or recovery behavior changes.
